--property-max-building-area.description: Maximum building area in square feet

--property-max-lot-size.description: Maximum lot size in square feet

--property-max-market-value.description: Maximum assessed market value in integer cents (100000000 = $1,000,000)

--property-min-building-area.description: Minimum building area in square feet

--property-min-lot-size.description: Minimum lot size in square feet

--property-min-market-value.description: Minimum assessed market value in integer cents (50000000 = $500,000)

--property-type.description: Property type, repeat or comma-separate for multiple: residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural, vacant land, exempt, miscellaneous, office, recreational

trust_summaries[].expected_miss_rate.description: Estimated share of true matches absent from arrived data due to ingestion lag.

trust_summaries[].row_weighted_unresolve.description: Row-weighted mean unresolved_rate across the page.

trust_summaries[].rows_flagged.description: Number of rows on the page carrying a trust flag.

trust_summaries[].suppressed_scopes.description: Number of footprint scopes excluded from the result by suppression.

assess_market_value.description: Assessed market value of the property, in cents (divide by 100 for dollars)

building_area.description: Building area of the property, in square feet

contractor_count.description: Distinct contractors across the address's permits.

id.description: The base64 address handle; the property's public id.

last_permit_date.description: Latest permit start_date across all of the address's permits; null when never permitted.

last_unfinaled_date_by_tag.description: Map tag -> latest non-final start_date under the clear rule.

lot_size.description: Lot size of the property, in square feet

permit_count.description: Count of permits linked to the address.

statuses.description: Distinct permit statuses incl the 'unknown' NULL fold.

story_count.description: Number of stories in the property.

tag_status_pairs.description: Distinct tag:status pairs (status folded to 'unknown' when NULL).

tags.description: Distinct canonical tags present on the address's permits.

total_job_value.description: Sum of the job values on the property's permits, in cents (divide by 100 for dollars)

trust.description: Per-row absence-honesty surface; present only on absence-class responses.

trust.coverage_tier.description: Coverage bucket for the row's jurisdiction (90/50 cutoffs).

trust.data_horizon.description: Most recent start_date past which 'no X since D' is under-observed; never null.

trust.flags.description: Row-grain honesty flags, e.g. since_d_beyond_horizon or trust_row_missing.

trust.footprint_basis.description: Whether footprint suppression could resolve the row's geo scope.

trust.horizon_basis.description: How data_horizon was estimated: a measured cohort, a pooled fallback, or the state prior.

trust.trust_jurisdiction_basis.description: Whether the trust join used the row's own jurisdiction, its ZIP's dominant one, or none.

trust.trust_jurisdiction_error_bar.description: Measured error rate of the trust jurisdiction: the 6.13% ZIP-dominant estimate error on a 'dominant' basis, 0 on an 'own' or 'unknown' basis.

trust.unresolved_rate.description: Share of the row jurisdiction's permits of the tag that never linked to an address.

unit_count.description: Number of units in the property.

untagged_permit_count.description: Count of the address's permits carrying no canonical tag.

field.description: Permit field name whose data coverage is being reported (e.g., fees, job_value)

fill_pct.description: Fraction of permits with this field populated, 0.0-1.0. Near 0 alongside permits_total > 0 means the location is covered but the source jurisdiction does not populate this field

permits_total.description: Total permits in the geography and date window used to compute fill_pct. 0 means no permit data in this window — either this area is not covered or no permits were filed in the period (not distinguishable from the response)

tier.description: Coverage tier of this field over the date window: missing (<10% filled), partial (10-80%). Reliable fields (>=80%) are omitted from the response, so an absent field is reliable

geo_id.description: Two-letter state abbreviation, used directly as geo_id

description.description: Human-readable description of what the tag represents

id.description: Tag identifier for use in --tags flags

field.description: Permit field name whose data coverage is being reported (e.g., fees, job_value)

fill_pct.description: Fraction of permits with this field populated, 0.0-1.0. Near 0 alongside permits_total > 0 means the location is covered but the source jurisdiction does not populate this field

permits_total.description: Total permits in the geography and date window used to compute fill_pct. 0 means no permit data in this window — either this area is not covered or no permits were filed in the period (not distinguishable from the response)

tier.description: Coverage tier of this field over the date window: missing (<10% filled), partial (10-80%). Reliable fields (>=80%) are omitted from the response, so an absent field is reliable

geo_id.description: 5-digit zip code, used directly as geo_id
